# Research & Projects

Original research exploring population health, healthcare outcomes,
healthcare utilization, and public policy.

## Completed research

### [County Diabetes, Obesity, and Hospital Utilization](diabetes-obesity-hospital-use.qmd)

An adjusted county-level regression analysis examining nonlinear
relationships between chronic disease prevalence and hospital stays.

**Methods:** Quadratic ordinary least squares regression, state fixed
effects, state-clustered standard errors, and adjusted prediction curves.

**Sample:** 2,684 counties across 48 state clusters.

## Future research

### Geographic Disparities in Preventable Mortality

An exploration of geographic variation in preventable mortality across
the United States.

### Predicting Preventable Hospitalizations

An investigation into predictive modeling and healthcare utilization.

### Evaluating Community-Based Healthcare

A causal evaluation of community-based healthcare interventions and
their impact on outcomes.
